description: Generate one image with an uncensored image model on OpenUncensored (ids and prices per image in list_models, e.g. z-image-turbo) and return it, with the model and provider that made it and the cost in USD charged to the account. Adult content is allowed; minors, real people without their consent and non consensual imagery are refused.

api_key.description: Defaults to the key in the MCP config.

model.description: Image model id from list_models, e.g. z-image-turbo

negative_prompt.description: Optional: what to keep out of the image.

name: generate_image
title: Generate an image
